blocks.prompt: 10. Find the general solution of the differential equation \(\sec^2x\tan y\,dx + \sec^2y\tan x\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Ghaur se dekhiye: har term (sirf \(x\) ka function) \(\times\) (sirf \(y\) ka function) hai, bas ghalat jagah par.
\(\tan x\tan y\) se divide karein to \(x\) wali cheezein \(dx\) ke saath aur \(y\) wali \(dy\) ke saath aa jati hain. Yani separable.
Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Plan: divide karenge; har fraction mein upar neeche ki derivative hai, to integral log banega; phir logs jorenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sec^2x\tan y\,dx + \sec^2y\tan x\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Separable hai. Har term ko \(\tan x\tan y\) se divide karenge, phir \(\int\frac{f'}{f} = \ln|f|\) wala rule lagayenge.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{\sec^2x}{\tan x}\,dx + \dfrac{\sec^2y}{\tan y}\,dy = 0\]
Kyun: Pehli term mein \(\tan y\) cancel hua aur \(\tan x\) neeche aaya; doosri mein \(\tan x\) cancel hua aur \(\tan y\) neeche aaya. Ab pehli term mein sirf \(x\) aur doosri mein sirf \(y\) hai.

Integrate karein
\[\ln|\tan x| + \ln|\tan y| = \ln|C|\]
Kyun: \(\tan x\) ki derivative \(\sec^2x\) hai, yani upar wala neeche wale ki derivative hai, to integral \(\ln|\tan x|\). Bilkul isi tarah \(y\) wala. Right side zero ka integral constant hai, jise \(\ln|C|\) likha.
Dhyan dein: \(\int\frac{\sec^2x}{\tan x}\,dx\) ko \(\tan x\) ya \(\sec x\) samajhna ghalat hai; yeh log hai.

Logs jorein aur hatayein
\[\ln|\tan x\tan y| = \ln|C|\]
\[\tan x\tan y = C\]
Kyun: \(\ln a + \ln b = \ln ab\). Logs barabar to andar wali cheezein barabar; sign \(C\) mein shamil ho gaya.

Tasdeeq
\(\tan x\tan y = C\) ko differentiate karein (product rule):
\[\sec^2x\tan y + \tan x\sec^2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0\]
Kyun: \(dx\) se multiply karein to \(\sec^2x\tan y\,dx + \sec^2y\tan x\,dy = 0\), bilkul di hui equation.
